The semi-empirical hardness model requires extracting bond lengths, electron density, overlap populations, and the metallicity factor from Mulliken analysis, demanding understanding of bonding analysis and careful parameter handling.

Orchestrating multiple Quantum ESPRESSO runs, phonopy post-processing, and custom data extraction/aggregation fits a multi-stage DFT workflow, though each step is relatively standard.
